description: The facts and description of one published catalogue record, by the slug in its collectorists.com address (/catalogue/{slug}). Coins: year, monarch, denomination, strike, metal, fineness, weight, diameter, mintage or edition limit. LEGO® sets: number, theme, pieces, minifigures, retirement status, UK retail price at LEGO.com with its date. Magic cards: set, rarity, type line, number of printings. Funko Pop! figures: line and box number.

slug.description: The record's slug, as returned by search_catalogue.

name: get_item
title: Get a catalogue record
